entries.title: See task spend and choose a project's cost limit
entries.body: Each task's record shows its estimated spend against its limit, including all its parts. In Settings → Projects, follow the app's limit, set a project's own amount or choose no limit. You can also ask your first mate to change the app's limit or a project's limit.

picture.alt: The Cost limit row in project settings offers Follow app, Own amount and No limit
